title: Land use (D1)
description: Frontage geometry, attraction weights and the unobtained retail vacancy. Land use is HELD FIXED BY DESIGN across all scenarios (proposal 4.2): endogenous land-use feedback would reintroduce the confounding the identification strategy exists to remove.

D.frontage.segment_length_m.description: Length of a Hunter St frontage segment. Hypothesis B1 is defined per 50 m segment, so this is fixed by the pre-registered metric, not tunable.

D.frontage.buffer_m.sweep_basis: chosen interval around the 30 m within which a building is attributed to one of the 50 m frontage segments (DECISIONS.md 7); half to five thirds of the value. No observed spread.
D.frontage.buffer_m.description: Distance from a frontage segment within which a building is attributed to it.

D.attraction.job_weight_by_category.sweep_basis: DECISIONS.md 7: the workplace-weighted POI index (office 12, civic 15, health 8, food 6, retail 4) is assumed because retail floorspace and vacancy were not obtained (13 priority 7); +/-40% on every weight, the proportional form being the honest expression of weights whose relative order is a judgement and whose magnitude is unobserved.
D.attraction.job_weight_by_category.description: Relative employment weight by POI category, used to distribute SA2 job counts to zones. Retail floorspace and vacancy were not obtained, so this stands in for them (DECISIONS.md 13 priority 7).

D.attraction.purpose_weight.sweep_basis: DECISIONS.md 7: the POI attraction weights by purpose are assumed and feed destination choice and frontage throughput; +/-40% on every weight, as for the job weights they extend. No observed spread.
D.attraction.purpose_weight.description: Destination attraction weight by trip purpose and POI category.

sweep.basis: no Newcastle frontage vacancy audit exists

D.retail.vacancy_rate.description: Frontage-level retail vacancy. NOT OBTAINED and not currently consumed by any metric. Registered so that hypothesis B2, which weights catchment by floorspace, cannot quietly acquire a vacancy assumption later without one appearing here.

D.attraction.education_population_floor.sweep_basis: 0 is no floor (attraction from mapped POIs only); 0.05 puts a school-sized attractor in every zone.
D.attraction.education_population_floor.description: Education attraction is floored at this share of a zone's population, so residential SA1s can host primary schools OSM has not mapped. Was an inline literal in the script until 12 September 2026 (#188).

D.landuse.poi_attraction_weights.sweep_basis: no observed pull per category exists in the package; every weight is swept by half either way.
D.landuse.poi_attraction_weights.description: Relative pedestrian pull per POI category group, used by the accessibility and frontage-throughput measures of the corridor landuse layer. Was an inline literal in the script until 12 September 2026 (#188).

D.landuse.retail_gfa_share.sweep_basis: ground-floor retail in a two- to four-storey main-street building is a quarter to a half of its GFA.
D.landuse.retail_gfa_share.description: The share of a frontage building's gross floor area taken as retail floor space, scaled by the retail/food share of its POI mix. Was an inline literal in the script until 12 September 2026 (#188).

D.landuse.frontage_unit_m.sweep_basis: a narrow shop is ~15 m of frontage, a large tenancy ~40.
D.landuse.frontage_unit_m.description: The frontage length one business is taken to occupy when the active-frontage percentage of a segment is computed. Was an inline literal in the script until 12 September 2026 (#188).
